notes: §1985:VI.5.15.3 SR4: "The VALUE clause must not be specified in any entry which is part of the description or redefinition of an external data record", while it "may be specified for condition-name entries". VersionConformancePass#VisitDataDescriptionEntry marks the whole record (the level-01 EXTERNAL entry, or a level-01 REDEFINES naming one) and #VisitValueClause checks construct value-clause-linkage-file-external-2002 (since 2002) on every non-88 VALUE inside it, so 85 refuses COBOL0900 and 2002 on accepts. Probes at 85: witness (05 under EXTERNAL) refused; VALUE on the 01 EXTERNAL itself, at level 15 of a nested group, signed scaled -12.5, edited, ALL "A", ZERO in PIC 9(18), an ODO object and an ODO table all refused; 01 REDEFINES of the external record with VALUE refused (plus COBOL2406); 88 VALUE/THRU entries under it accepted and run ("88 OK"); a following local 01 and 77 VALUE and a contained program's local VALUE beside its EXTERNAL record accepted. At 2002/2023 the witness compiles.

next.reason: 1985: "The VALUE clause must not be specified in any entry which is part of the description or redefinition of an external data record."; 2023: "None of the VALUE clause syntax rules 1-39 (SR-13.18.63.3-1..39) bars VALUE in external data; SR-12 bars it only under REDEFINES.". 2023's full set of VALUE clause syntax rules is shown, and none forbids VALUE in external records, so the restriction appears dropped. Its REDEFINES rule covers only part of it.
